messages:
maya: FYI the DAST pre-merge runner is failing on all web scans after yesterday's IAM clean-up. Likely related to the KMS key used to decrypt staging fixtures. Blocking a few release PRs.

security-bot: automated alert: SEC-801  DAST runner KMS decrypt denied on key projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/web-fixtures.

trevor: can you paste the error?

maya: pasted from the pipeline job:
```
Error: KMS: Decrypt failed: AccessDenied.
Key: projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/web-fixtures
Principal: serviceAccount:dast-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Operation time: 2026-03-23T09:12:41Z
```

sre: confirmed in audit logs: "permission denied" events at the exact timestamp. Looks like the folder-level binding that previously allowed scanner SAs to decrypt was removed in the cleanup.

auditor: we need an auditable short-term fix. No one wants permanent broad grants. Proposal: ephemeral grant for that SA with a 1-hour TTL and record the change as an approval in SEC-801 with justification and CI run id.

trevor: agreed. Two follow-ups: (A) patch the pipeline to use explicit workload identity / SA impersonation so it doesn't rely on inherited bindings, (B) create a pre-merge permission check job that runs a KMS decrypt dry-run on the same key and fails fast if perms are missing.

jen: +1 for the pre-merge check. We already have a tiny job template used for GCS writes, expand it to KMS decrypt CLI check. Example script:
```bash
# pre-merge kms healthcheck
gcloud kms keys versions decrypt --location=global --keyring=staging --key=web-fixtures --ciphertext-file=/dev/null --quiet || exit 1
```

maya: I'll apply the ephemeral binding now (using iam conditions TTL) and link the change in SEC-801. After that I'll re-run the pipeline.

security-bot: SEC-801 updated: temporary grant applied by maya (ttl=1h). Next actions: maya (run & revoke), trevor (pipeline SA migration), jen (add pre-merge KMS check), auditor (verify audit entries).

sre: reminder: when granting ephemeral access, use the least-privilege principal and key-level binding. Also enable key audit logs to a restricted sink for the window and copy the relevant log entries into the SEC ticket.

auditor: we'll accept that flow as long as we have: 1) a recorded approval in the ticket, 2) the exact IAM diff, 3) exported audit logs for the window, and 4) an IP/agent fingerprint for the pipeline run.

maya: pipeline rerun queued. will report back in ~7m.

security-bot: note added to SEC-801: follow-up playbook draft requested for ephemeral scanner grants and pre-merge KMS permission checks.

maya: rerun passed. DAST completed on the blocked PRs. I'll revoke the grant in 5m and attach audit logs to SEC-801. Thanks.

jen: after revoke, can you add an issue to the infra board to roll out the SA impersonation plan? We should timeline that before the next release.

trevor: renaming action item: INFRA-1423 - migrate DAST runners to explicit SA impersonation + pre-merge kms healthcheck.

auditor: closing loop: once logs are attached to SEC-801 and INFRA-1423 is created, we'll mark this as remediated and schedule a short postmortem in the weekly security sync.

maya: done. SEC-801 updated with diff and logs, INFRA-1423 opened, and PRs unblocked. :white_check_mark:
